text: {"lessons":["Selling at a profit feels good, but I should not let that satisfaction decide when to sell; use a consistent plan based on future prospects.","A large gain, like the one on Stock D, is not by itself a reason to sell or hold; reassess each position on its merits.","My account rose overall despite month-to-month fluctuations and little trading, reinforcing that random past price changes are not reliable signals and I should avoid impulsive trades."]}
